label: Bible Study
prompt: Thou wilt keep him in perfect _____, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
note: The Hebrew doubles it — 'shalom shalom': peace, and then peace again.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is good unto them that _____ for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verse: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
note: Waiting is the one spiritual discipline nobody volunteers for, and the LORD is good in it.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then went he down, and dipped himself _____ times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verse: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
note: Naaman wanted something grander, but the cure was seven dips in the muddy old Jordan.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in _____ shall be your strength: and ye would not.
verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
note: God's rescue plan was rest and quiet trust; Judah preferred fast horses. Note the ending: 'and ye would not.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Whom God hath set forth to be a _____ through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
verse: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
note: The great atonement word: a sacrifice that satisfies. Every seminarian's flashcard, right here.
